Name: Trash Can Expanded - Better Loot and Dumpster Diving
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Trash Can Expanded

[/b][/size][b][size=3]"One man's trash is another farmer's treasure!"
[/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][/center][b][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]
[quote][size=3]This mod doesn't override base game Trash, it's on top of what you will normally get from the Trash bin.
[/size][/quote][/b]
Do you ever feel like the trash cans in Pelican Town are a little too empty? You risk your reputation (and Linus's judgment) to dig through them, only to find... nothing?

[b]Trash Can Expanded[/b] makes the life of a dumpster diver worth living. This mod adds a secondary loot system to every trash can in the game, giving you a chance to find extra items—from simple snacks to rare valuables—based on the day of the week.

[center][b][color=#ffff00]For Demo purpose, chance was set to 100%[/color][/b][/center]
[center][img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcjZqdDA4aml2NjFiNnlrdm9nNHE0aHk4MnYwNDJxdDZod2JweGhjZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/BL5GI78Ij5gbX9sHmK/giphy.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[b][size=3]The "Weekend Cleaning" Schedule
[/size][/b]
The villagers have a life, and their trash habits reflect that! The chance of finding items changes every day based on an immersive logic:

[list]
[*][b]Monday - Thursday (10% Chance):[/b] Just the standard weekday trash. Most people are busy working, so loot is scarce.
[*][b]Friday (25% Chance):[/b] [b]Spring Cleaning![/b] The villagers are tidying up their homes to get ready for the weekend. You will find a lot more goods tossed out today.
[*][b]Saturday (5% Chance):[/b] [b]Collection Day.[/b] The garbage trucks presumably came early. The bins are mostly empty, so don't expect much.
[*][b]Sunday (30% Chance):[/b] [b]The Jackpot.[/b] After Saturday night dinners and weekend parties, the cans are overflowing with leftovers and discarded gifts. This is the best day to go on a trash run!
[/list][b][size=3]
Smart Loot System
[/size][/b]
This isn't just random junk. The mod uses a [b]Weighted "Jackpot" System[/b] to decide what you get.

[list]
[*]It pulls from the game's item list, filtering out quest items.
[*][b]Common Items:[/b] Cheap items (crops, wood, basic food) are highly likely to appear.
[*][b]Rare Items:[/b] Valuable items (gems, bars, artisan goods) are possible but much rarer.
[*][b]The Math:[/b] An item worth 50g is roughly 7x more likely to spawn than an item worth 450g.
[/list]You might find a Parsnip, or you might find a Diamond... do you feel lucky?

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41095/41095-1768007305-2038116165.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[list]
[/list][b][size=3]Configuration
[/size][/b]
This mod is fully compatible with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]. You can change everything in-game:

[list]
[*][b]Daily Chances:[/b] Want every day to be a 100% loot fest? You can do that.
[*][b]Max Item Value:[/b] By default, items over 500g won't spawn (to prevent getting Prismatic Shards in Spring Year 1). You can raise or lower this limit.
[*][b]Enable/Disable:[/b] Toggle the mod on the fly.
[/list]
[center][youtube]VZ2wGsQnhyk[/youtube]﻿[/center][list=1]

[/list][b][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/b] 

Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+. Safe to add or remove from existing saves. Works in Multiplayer (each player has their own luck).
